This '''unidentified planet''' had at least one [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] called [[Lasgo Port]]. The planet was surrounded by a minefield which had been left there during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[139 ABY]], the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[AG-37]] and his companions visited this planet while delivering supplies. During their visit, his friend [[Ania Solo]] attempted to tame a [[yarthul]] but lost and was forced to hand over her [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] as collateral. Later, Ania discovered that the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] had placed a bounty on her head for the alleged murder of the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Teemen Alton]]. Shortly later, Ania was kidnapped by her former lover [[Ramid]], who also attempted to blow up [[AG-37's freighter]] in the orbital minefield.<ref name="Legacy" />
